name: MICROLN
recent: Microlink Solutions Berhad 在截至2026年9月30日的第一季度转为净亏损 RM3.119 million，营收同比下降 11.8%。公司宣布 Yap Shon Leong 于2026年11月17日就任执行董事，同时 Datin Seri Yasmin Hanim 旗下的 Teguh Sedaya 在收购2000万股后增持公司股份。公司将于2026年12月1日召开第23届年度股东大会。
notable: 截至2026年9月30日的第一季度转为净亏损 RM3.119 million，营收同比下降 11.8%。
Teguh Sedaya 在收购2000万股后增持公司股份。
Yap Shon Leong 于2026年11月17日被委任为执行董事。
risks: 公司于2026年9月11日公告重大诉讼。
截至2026年9月30日的第一季度录得净亏损 RM3.119 million。
Narayanasamy A/L N Chithambaram 将于2026年12月1日退任非独立非执行董事。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的财年，营收为 RM178.218 million，净亏损为 RM5.666 million，净利率为 -3.2%。按季度比较，营收环比增长 81.6%，同比增长 243.6%，净利率从上一期的 -4.0% 改善至 -3.2%。

recent_en: Microlink Solutions Berhad swung to a net loss of RM3.119 million in the first quarter ended 30 September 2026, with revenue falling 11.8% year-on-year. The company appointed Yap Shon Leong as Executive Director effective 17 November 2026, while Datin Seri Yasmin Hanim's Teguh Sedaya raised its interest after acquiring 20 million shares.
notable_en: Swung to a net loss of RM3.119 million in the first quarter ended 30 September 2026, with revenue down 11.8% year-on-year.
Teguh Sedaya raised its interest in the company after acquiring 20 million shares.
Yap Shon Leong was appointed as Executive Director effective 17 November 2026.
risks_en: The company announced a material litigation on 11 September 2026.
Recorded a net loss of RM3.119 million for the first quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Narayanasamy A/L N Chithambaram will retire as Non-Independent Non-Executive Director effective 1 December 2026.
earnings_en: For the financial year ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM178.218 million with a net loss of RM5.666 million and a net margin of -3.2%. On a quarterly basis, revenue grew 81.6% quarter-on-quarter and 243.6% year-on-year, while net margin improved from -4.0% in the previous period to -3.2%.
